purpose: Build each CPU LK image pyramid once and reuse the owned pair across forward/backward tracking for built-in scalar components.

contract.math: Keep option/shape/threshold error ordering, scalar conversion, floor-halved box pyramid, per-point LK arithmetic/order, guesses, status and round-trip hypot/threshold unchanged. Reuse only u8/u16/f32/f64; user-defined PixelComponent conversions keep the original two public calls and conversion observations. No public API, dependency, core, GPU or transfer change.
contract.ownership: A private owned pair retains two immutable f32 pyramids through both directions. No cross-call cache or caller alias. Four pyramid constructions become two for built-in robust calls; peak pyramid payload remains two. This is CPU preparation reuse, not a GPU kernel or RSS guarantee.
contract.verification: Characterize new two-public-call references before implementation; require exact coordinate/error bits and statuses across built-in dtypes, options, non-finite/duplicate/empty points, strided subviews, errors and observable custom conversions. Compare actual parent/candidate WASM complete reports and retain all existing browser/model controls. Use in-process interleaved frozen two-call versus candidate measurements, publish every row including adverse results, and verify independent parent executable camera reports.
contract.preservation: Preserve all prior camera/renderer files, isolated Cargo target, 493 scientific JSON, 42 frozen native artifacts, room/reference outputs, both existing raw WASM files and resolved lock. Build only feature-scoped vision/web code in a fresh isolated E-drive target with locked/offline installed toolchains. No sensor/model/SDK/browser/toolchain acquisition or sensor payload copies.

resources.strategy: Fresh isolated Cargo outputs, no compiler-output hardlinks. Reuse hash-checked vendor and parent package files. Sample bytes and preserve old artifacts before/after each owned command. Retry only transient vanished entries in the owned live Cargo subtree, at most three complete snapshots; fail on unrelated/persistent errors.

benchmark.options: radius 5, levels 3, 30 iterations, epsilon 0.001, minimum eigenvalue 0.0001, round-trip threshold 1
benchmark.comparison: Frozen original two-public-call flow and candidate robust API in the same process; compare complete coordinates/status/error bits outside timing. Keep all samples and adverse rows. CPU affinity/frequency, other host load and allocation effects are uncontrolled. No physical-phone, GPU or end-to-end speed claim.

remaining_80_percent: Measured calibration/timing and independent motion, full-room accuracy, qualifying physical Linux hardware and integrated operational acceptance remain open.
